build_opensearch_vector_client: build an OpenSearch vector database client for storing and retrieving text embeddings with HNSW indexing
create_opensearch_index: create an OpenSearch index with KNN vector mappings and HNSW similarity search configuration
search_opensearch_collection: search an OpenSearch collection using vector similarity with optional metadata filters and result limits
insert_opensearch_items: insert vector items with text and metadata into an OpenSearch collection using bulk indexing
delete_opensearch_items: delete items from an OpenSearch collection by ids or metadata filter criteria
